description: Endowment Governance is the federation organisation that invests the endowment corpus and funds Core through a recurring income stream. It supplies and withdraws test USDC and WETH to and from the Aave v3 pool on Ethereum Sepolia, holding the resulting interest-bearing aTokens in its own treasury (the Powers contract itself). New investments pass a Core organisational veto window; divestment stays fast and cannot be vetoed, so the endowment can always retreat to safety. A throttled, rules-based income stream pays a fixed per-period amount of USDC upward to Core, following the horizontal fiscal equalisation pattern. Elected Endowment Investors govern investment strategy and self-govern reform.
